id: title:fivestarspicy:stop cutting a new scout s name at 45 characters

P1.F6.H2 and P1.F6.H3 establish display-name and skill-name ID bounds and relationships. P1.F6.H9, P1.F6.H10, and P1.F7.H2 introduce new parameters and dependencies. review.uncertainty: The chunk is not complete; P1.F6.H9 and P1.F6.H10 depend on missing implementations, and P1.F7.H2 tests depend on missing implementation. This prevents a complete assessment of the tier.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by P1.F3.H1, a complete new test file. P1.F1.H1 is a dependency change. P1.F2 and P1.F4 hunks are implementation and test changes. No score assigned.

observations.posthog_connection: Adds a testing dependency; no implementation change shown.

observations.behavior: Adds useRef and SCOUT_DISPLAY_NAME_MAX_LENGTH import; changes template creation to include scannerName; adds a useEffect to set form name to template default until scanner loads; adds scannerLoaded check; changes input onChange to mark nameTouched; uses SCOUT_DISPLAY_NAME_MAX_LENGTH instead of template-dependent length.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a race-condition guard: the form waits for the scanner to load before using the scanner's name, preventing a placeholder name from being baked into the skill name. This could prevent incorrect skill names and downstream issues.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a 200-char display-name cap and a 64-char skill-name id, and a 14-char prefix, while retaining the 64-char id and 3-char collision suffix. P1.F6.H2: P1.F6.H3: P1.F6.H5: P1.F6.H6: P1.F6.H7: P1.F6.H8
observations.posthog_connection: The display name is stored in the Signals scout config API and shown to users; the skill name is the backend id. This chunk establishes the display-name bound and the id-bound, and the relationship between them.

observations.behavior: Replaces the old name-to-skill-name function with a new one, and the new one no longer uses the typed name, but the scanner and the template key. P1.F6.H3: P1.F6.H5: P1.F6.H6: P1.F6.H7: P1.F6.H8
observations.posthog_connection: The skill name is the id, not the display name. The id is derived from the scanner and the template, not the typed name, so the typed name does not bound the id. This chunk establishes the id and the relationship between the scanner and the template.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the referenced function `scoutSkillName` or the definition of `scoutDefaultName`. The tests and the main logic depend on these, but their implementation is absent. This prevents a complete assessment of the tier.

observations.behavior: Adds a dependency on a new function `scoutSkillName` and a new default name generator, while removing the old `scoutNameToSkillName` and a static default name.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the default name for a newly created scout, potentially affecting the user experience and the generated skill name, but the implementation of these new functions is not supplied.

observations.behavior: Adds a new parameter `scannerName` to the template selection function and passes it to the underlying template lookup.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the template selection to depend on the scanner name, potentially changing which template is chosen, but the implementation of the underlying lookup is not supplied.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for the typed name and the associated ID, and a test for the case where the display name cannot be recorded.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds tests for the new behavior of recording the typed name and handling failures, but the implementation of the recording and failure handling is not supplied.
